sources.title: FLoRIN — florin 0.0.1a documentation
sources.snippet: FLoRIN, the Flexible Learning-free Reconstruction of Neural Volumes pipeline, is a pipeline for large-scale parallel and distributed computer vision. Offering easy setup and access to hierarchical parallelism, FLorIN is ideal for scaling computer vision to HPC systems.

sources.title: Florin — Florin: insurance bound in minutes, with zero underwriters and ...
sources.snippet: Florin's tagline, "Insurance, bound in minutes," is a direct attack on that bottleneck. The company's website lists three lines of business: Liability, Products, and Property. These are broad categories, but the emphasis on "hard-to-price risks" suggests Florin is not going after standard auto or home policies.
